title: Go for the WIN! The Selling Power of Sports + TV

facts.fact: According to EDO, women's sports saw a 131% increase in viewership in 2024.
facts.quote: fueled by a 131% increase in viewership in 2024

facts.fact: According to EDO, women's sports ads brought 40% more ad impact than the average primetime ad in 2024.
facts.quote: Women’s sports ads also brought 40% more ad impact than the average primetime ad last year.

facts.fact: EDO analyzed every single national TV ad across a range of recent women's sports programming for its report.
facts.quote: They analyzed every single national TV ad across a range of recent women’s sports programming

facts.fact: Centriply's summary of women's sports coverage shows the majority of advertiser impression activity occurs between March and October on both broadcast and cable providers.
facts.quote: The majority of activity is between March and October on both broadcast and cable providers.
